item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 26/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the anticyclone aloft, it will be mainly fine over Guangdong today and tomorrow, but high temperatures will also trigger showers over inland areas. An upper-air disturbance will bring showers to the coast of southern China during the weekend. A tropical cyclone is expected to form over east of Luzon Strait and move towards the vicinity of Taiwan to the East China Sea early next week. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, the weather will be very hot over southern China. The northeast monsoon will reach Guangdong on Tuesday. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large and it will be dry over the region midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Cimaron will move across the seas south of Japan today and tomorrow, it will then transform into an extratropical cyclone gradually.
